_comment: t/4323 — CI size ratchet for instruction files. Each entry's max_lines/max_words is seeded at the file's measured size on 2026-10-20 (git ls-files confirmed: these are the only AGENTS.md files tracked by the main repo, and therefore the only ones a GitHub Actions checkout can see). Bump a budget deliberately, in the same PR that grows the file, when growth is intended — see scripts/check-agents-md-budget.mjs and the 'agents-md-budget' CI job.
